test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I always __encouraging people to read books__ which I have enjoyed reading myself.

options.text: encourage people to be reading books

solution:
The correct answer is 'encourage people to read books'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Simple Present Tense.
 
• The structure for a sentence in **Simple** Present Tense:
 
 
• Structure: Subject + V1 + s/es(if subject is singular) + object
 
• *Example: Emma watches cartoons every day. *
 
 
 
• The V1 for the word 'encouraging' is 'encourage'.

 
• Correct sentence:* I always ****encourage people to read books__** which I have enjoyed reading myself.*
